entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This is an appeal filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 against the Judgment &
Award dated 04.07.2024 passed by the learned Member, MACT, Morigaon in MAC (Death) Case No. 08/2021.

The learned counsel for the appellant has filed the instant appeal on the grounds that the learned Tribunal had erred in granting compensation to the dependants of the deceased in spite of them getting financial assistance under the scheme for Compassionate Family Pension Scheme (CFP)
issued by the State Government dated 14.09.2017.
Issue notice to the respondents through registered post with A/D within 2 days returnable by three weeks as well as through usual process.
Meanwhile, LCR is to be called for.
